# Best Brisbane consultancies for workflow automation and Microsoft Power Automate

If you're looking to automate business processes in Brisbane, I'd shortlist consultancies that combine **business process analysis, Microsoft Power Automate implementation, and integration with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Excel, Teams, and business systems**\.

I searched for Brisbane-based providers and Microsoft specialists. My strongest initial candidates are **Secure Minded, 365 Architechs, Essential Tech, North Ark, and Office Experts Group**\. They offer different strengths, from hands-on workflow development to broader Microsoft consulting. This is a shortlist based on published services and evidence, not a definitive ranking of delivery quality.

## My top recommendations

![Expert Managed IT Support for Brisbane Businesses](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/22CXU1VifBAzSvHFjGlg0rFXjceGcujJs9YBnp40Em-v_AMtJtUxmFPv9d9lUJPjbGIb9z4SWiGgXXUYzQuDRsL22OhG65DozG3tfajt46eqY9umZRW-h4cNnP7dh5a8Ug-QGS2BHfebTvf_3G60qo17usZ3QPuE6rFlutcuFC-6GM4CmZfYk8CnwntIgiGA?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. Secure Minded

(Best overall starting point)

Brisbane · [secureminded.au](https://www.secureminded.au/)

Specialises in Power Automate, Power Apps, business analysis, data integration and AI-enabled automation. Its published examples include automating community-care administration and improving inventory visibility for a food distributor. It also describes a process of understanding the business first, then designing, building and handing over documented solutions. [secureminded.au](https://secureminded.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.secureminded.au](https://www.secureminded.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** SMEs and mid-sized businesses wanting practical automation tailored to real operational problems, with training and ongoing support.

---



## 2\. 365 Architechs

East Brisbane · [Company profile and contact details](https://workforcedirectory.com.au/vendor/365-architechs/)

An Australian-owned consultancy working across Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Business Central, Azure and the Power Platform. Its services include workflow automation, document management, dashboards and custom applications, with implementation and ongoing support. [workforcedirectory.com.au](https://workforcedirectory.com.au/vendor/365-architechs/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Businesses already using Microsoft 365 that want connected workflows, document automation and broader Microsoft business-system integration.

## 3\. Essential Tech

Brisbane CBD · [essentialtech.com.au/power-automate](https://essentialtech.com.au/power-automate/)

Has a dedicated Power Automate consulting offering focused on streamlining manual processes and maintaining automation as business needs evolve. Its Brisbane office is at Level 11, 157 Ann Street. [essentialtech.com.au](https://essentialtech.com.au/power-automate/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Organisations that want Power Automate implementation alongside a broader IT support relationship.

---

![FUJIFILM Business Innovation | New Zealand](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/-iIhuj8GuJ6L1Ey0k42gFOjgc_e4cGaw75KN82_8W-HUxqHizEVAPnjVeuWRgxokShdheQvk64UIr576RUn0EDeevkfIjbTrawH_FgUsjM0jA0ol4dTpQJpHkCyCwm9ePzf8KM9oYZdgeRHlUMe9thL5is3-2TOuTOMezLsL7jVn4IoxhamYuLMj-Z89v39G?purpose=fullsize)

## 4\. North Ark

Brisbane-based · [northark.com.au/workflow-automation](https://northark.com.au/custom-software/workflow-automation/)

Focuses on workflow automation that accounts for exceptions, approvals, system integration and repetitive administrative work. It identifies itself as a Microsoft Partner and highlights certified engineers. [northark.com.au](https://northark.com.au/custom-software/workflow-automation/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** More complex workflows involving multiple systems, exception handling or processes that need custom development beyond straightforward low-code flows.

## 5\. Office Experts Group

Brisbane and South East Queensland · [officeexperts.com.au](https://www.officeexperts.com.au/microsoft-consultants-brisbane)

Offers Power Platform solutions using Power Automate, Power Apps and Power BI, as well as Excel automation and automated Word document generation. It reports more than 25 years of Microsoft expertise and provides onsite consulting across Brisbane. [www.officeexperts.com.au](https://www.officeexperts.com.au/microsoft-consultants-brisbane?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Excel-heavy businesses, document-intensive teams and organisations wanting to improve existing Microsoft workflows without necessarily replacing their systems.

[clouddownunder.com.au](https://clouddownunder.com.au/)

A broader Microsoft Solutions Partner offering Power Platform automation, Azure, Microsoft 365 and business applications. Worth considering when automation involves cloud architecture, security or enterprise integration. [clouddownunder.com.au](https://clouddownunder.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

**Strategik**

[strategik.com.au](https://www.strategik.com.au/)

Combines Power Platform automation with ERP improvement, Power BI reporting and custom business applications. Particularly relevant when workflow automation needs to solve underlying reporting or data problems too. [www.officeexperts.com.au](https://www.officeexperts.com.au/microsoft-consultants-brisbane?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.strategik.com.au](https://www.strategik.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Which should you choose?

| Your requirement | My first call |
|--------|--------|
| Automate everyday admin and operational processes | Secure Minded |
| Connect SharePoint, Microsoft 365 and business applications | 365 Architechs |
| Power Automate plus general IT support | Essential Tech |
| Complex, multi-system workflows with exceptions | North Ark |
| Excel, Word and document-heavy processes | Office Experts Group |
| Enterprise cloud architecture and security | Cloud Down Under |
| ERP, reporting and automation together | Strategik |


These are fit-based recommendations drawn from each provider's published capabilities, rather than independently verified head-to-head performance comparisons.

## What to ask before engaging a consultancy

I'd ask each shortlisted provider to demonstrate how it would approach one real workflow in your business.

- **Process discovery\:** Will they map the current process and identify inefficiencies before building?
- **Implementation\:** Can they build cloud flows, approval workflows, document generation and integrations with your existing systems?
- **Reliability\:** How do they handle failed flows, exceptions, duplicate records and alerts?
- **Governance\:** Will they configure service accounts, permissions, environments, deployment practices and appropriate monitoring?
- **Handover\:** Are documentation, staff training, ownership of the flows and post-launch support included?
- **Commercial model\:** Can they quote a small pilot with clear deliverables before proposing a larger project?

For a straightforward workflow, I would start with a tightly scoped pilot rather than committing to a large digital-transformation engagement.

## Let me narrow this to the best two or three

What sort of business workflow are you looking to automate? For example, invoice processing, approvals, CRM updates, document generation, reporting, staff onboarding, or information moving between Excel, SharePoint, Outlook and other systems.

That will make a substantial difference to which consultancy is the best fit for your project.
